title.en: An Act Appropriating Funds for Public Works
title.orig: An Act Amending Certain Items in Republic Act Numbered One Thousand Six Hundred Thirteen, Entitled “An Act Appropriating Funds for Public Works”

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1957/ra_1754_1957.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en:
Item sixteen, Appendix B, School Buildings, page seventy-B, for the Province of Negros Oriental, second congressional district, of Republic Act Numbered One thousand six hundred thirteen is hereby amended to read as follows:
"16. Siquijor - Cang-alwang—Aid to PTA for reconstruction and construction ₱5,000.00 "16(a) Siquijor - Poblacion—Repairs and fencing of the Siquijor Central Primary School 2,000.00 "16(b) Siquijor - Cantabon—Aid to PTA school building 1,000.00 "16(c) Siquijor - Panlautan—Aid to PTA school building 1,000.00 "16(d) Siquijor - Pulangyuta—For fencing and ground improvement, Siquijor Elementary school 1,000.00"

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 21, 1957.
